h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in North Dumdum

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in North Dum Dum

c: North Dum Dum lies just beyond Kolkata's airport, an old residential municipality of narrow lanes, local clubs and neighbourhood playgrounds. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in North Dum Dum for the municipality, schools, clubs and apartment complexes. Every machine is made at our Vasai factory, about 1650 km away, and travels to Bengal by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India fixes it on site. The area is humid for most of the year, with a long monsoon that can leave low parks soaked for days. Galvanised frames resist rust, and a raised concrete base keeps footings dry. Neighbourhood parks here are often small and shared with children, so we plan machines along one edge and keep the middle free for play.

items.q: How many machines fit in a small neighbourhood park?
items.a: Often three or four along one edge. Send us the length and width of the park and photos, and we will mark machines and clear space on a layout drawing.

items.q: Does the long monsoon damage outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Galvanised frames resist rust in wet weather. The main risk is water around the footings, so use a raised, sloping base and clear standing water after rain.

items.q: Can a club or municipality in North Dum Dum place an order?
items.a: Yes. Clubs, schools, apartment associations and civic bodies all buy from us. You approve the layout and quote, and we manufacture, dispatch and install.
